correctness.rationale: Shortest-path matrix verified by independent BFS. Exact zero-sum sector decomposition and nonstandard strict sector inequalities proved for p<=1 (all pages) and p<=6/5 (two pages); rational fifth-power interval proves the upper endpoint sign. The first determinant root gives a rank-one boundary, and Li–Weston strict-interior theorem prevents any higher negative type. Uniform determinant expansion yields the claimed inverse-page law. The standalone checker completed 59 supplementary assertion groups.
